title: Merged array on right-hand indices
statement: Let $g_1 : \mathrm{Fin}\,m_1 \to \alpha$ and $g_2 : \mathrm{Fin}\,m_2 \to \alpha$ be gate arrays, and let $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,m_2$. Then the merged array of $g_1$ and $g_2$ takes the value $g_2(i)$ at the index $m_1 + i$.
replaced:
For every $i : \mathrm{Fin}\,m_2$, evaluating the merged array at the right-embedded index
$\mathrm{natAdd}\,m_1\,i$ recovers $g_2\,i$, i.e.
$\mathrm{mergeGates}\,g_1\,g_2\,(\mathrm{natAdd}\,m_1\,i) = g_2\,i$.
